Process Ownership: Take responsibility for assigned administrative activities, ensuring tasks are completed accurately, on time and to a high standard.

Ideal Commercial Administrative Assistant

Commercial Administration Experience: Previous experience within an administrative, customer service, sales support or commercial support environment.

CRM / ERP Systems Experience: Experience using business systems to manage enquiries, customer records, work orders or operational activity.

Commercial Documentation Experience: Experience preparing, processing or maintaining quotations, purchase orders, work orders or related business documentation.

Multi-Tasking & Prioritisation: Comfortable managing multiple activities simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.

Strong Communicator: Able to communicate confidently and professionally with customers, suppliers and colleagues.

Organised & Detail-Oriented: Strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise effectively and manage competing deadlines.

Proactive Approach: Takes ownership of tasks, follows actions through to completion and works independently when required.

Team Player: Enjoys working collaboratively across multiple departments and contributing to wider business objectives.

Industry Experience: Experience within engineering, manufacturing, service, logistics, construction or other operational environments would be advantageous but is not essential.

title: Part time Finance Manager
description:
A well established and growing Sheffield based business is looking to appoint an experienced Part time Finance Manager to take ownership of its finance function and provide clear, commercially focussed financial insight to the senior management team.

This is a genuinely broad role for someone who enjoys being close to the detail but can also step back and understand the bigger commercial picture. Reporting into the COO, you'll have ownership across the day-to-day finance function, while playing an important role in supporting the wider business as it continues to develop and grow.

The role

You'll take responsibility for the preparation of monthly management accounts, budgeting, forecasting and cash flow, alongside maintaining strong financial controls across the business.

There is also a strong commercial element to the position. You'll work closely with the CEO, COO and senior managers, providing analysis around profitability, margins, costs and performance, as well as helping the wider business understand the financial impact of operational and commercial decisions.

The role will also oversee transactional finance activity, including purchase and sales ledger, credit control, bank reconciliations and balance sheet controls, alongside responsibility for VAT, year-end accounts and liaison with external accountants and advisers.

As the business continues to develop existing services and explore new opportunities, you'll also have the opportunity to support financial modelling, business cases, new contracts and investment decisions.

What we're looking for

We're looking for someone with strong management accounting or financial management experience who is comfortable taking ownership rather than simply producing accounts.

ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent would be desirable, although suitably experienced qualified-by-experience candidates will also be considered.

Most importantly, you'll be commercially minded, hands-on and confident communicating financial information to non-finance stakeholders.

Why consider it?

The attraction of this role is the level of ownership and influence it offers, alongside the flexibility of a part-time position.

You'll have genuine visibility across the business, working closely with senior management and having the opportunity to shape the quality of financial information, processes and controls as the Group continues to evolve.

For an experienced Finance Manager looking for a part-time opportunity where they can make a tangible difference, this offers considerably more scope than a traditional part-time finance position.

Sharp Consultancy is a finance and accountancy recruitment specialist assisting accounting and finance divisions of businesses in the Yorkshire and Derbyshire area. With over 30 years' experience we pride ourselves on sourcing excellent finance professionals across all divisions of an accounts function.

Candidates must be eligible to work in the UK full time without restriction. To apply please send your CV to the e-mail address stated, quoting our reference and specifying which website you saw this position advertised on. title: Service Administrator
company: Sue Ross Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Contract
description:
Sue Ross Recruitment are delighted to be working with a well-established and highly respected organisation within the healthcare and technical services sector who are seeking an experienced Service Administrator to join their Sheffield-based team.

This is a varied and fast-paced role, providing operational, administrative and customer support to a busy technical services department. The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring the efficient processing of service and repair jobs, supporting engineers in the field, coordinating workloads, and delivering exceptional customer service to both internal and external stakeholders.

Customer Service & Administration
- Act as the first point of contact for customer enquiries relating to service, repair and maintenance activities.
- Process and monitor service and repair jobs, ensuring customers and internal teams receive timely updates.
- Prepare quotations, process repair orders and manage associated contract administration.
- Record, investigate and escalate customer feedback, complaints and quality issues where required.
- Liaise with third-party suppliers, repair partners and internal departments to ensure service targets are achieved.
- Maintain accurate records, documentation and system data to ensure compliance and audit readiness.

Planning & Scheduling
- Coordinate and schedule planned maintenance activities and reactive service visits for field service engineers across the UK.
- Allocate resources effectively to maximise efficiency and meet customer requirements.
- Triage technical enquiries and ensure requests are directed to the appropriate support channels.
- Monitor workload and service schedules to ensure agreed KPIs and service levels are achieved.

Operational Support
- Support the smooth day-to-day operation of the technical services function.
- Track service activities and provide updates to stakeholders.
- Assist with performance reporting and continuous improvement initiatives.
- Ensure all departmental systems and processes remain accurate and up to date.
- Work closely with engineering teams to support effective service delivery.

The Successful Candidate Will Have
- Previous experience within a customer service, service coordination, operational support or scheduling environment.
- Strong administration skills with excellent attention to detail.
- Experience planning and coordinating workloads, engineers, service teams or field-based resources.
- Excellent communication skills and the ability to build positive relationships with customers and colleagues.
- Strong organisational and prioritisation skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
- Experience using a range of IT systems and Microsoft Office applications.
- A proactive approach and a commitment to delivering excellent customer service.

What's on Offer?
- Opportunity to join a market-leading organisation with an excellent reputation.
- Varied and rewarding role within a supportive team environment.
- Ongoing training and professional development opportunities.
- Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.
- We are able to consider candidates who are available immediately on a temporary basis , but we are also happy to receive applications if you are seeking a permanent role also.

Unfortunately due to the number of applications we receive, we are unable to provide individual feedback to all applicants. Please assume that if you do not hear from us within 72 hours that your application has been unsuccessful on this occasion.

May we take this opportunity to thank you for expressing an interest in one of our roles and wish you the very best in your search for employment.

title: Social Media Executive
description:
Social Media Executive
Sheffield Full-time

Elevation Recruitment Group are delighted to be working with a high-profile organisation who are looking to appoint a Social Media Executive to join their growing Marketing team, based in Sheffield.

This is an exciting opportunity for a creative and digitally savvy social media professional to take ownership of engaging, platform-first content across a recognisable brand, working across campaigns, live activity and day-to-day content.

What's on Offer?
- Salary of c£27,000
- A varied and genuinely creative role with exposure across multiple social platforms.
- The opportunity to work on campaigns, live activity and commercially focused content.
- A collaborative and fast-paced marketing environment.
- The opportunity to develop your social media career within a high-profile and engaging brand.

You'll play a key role in growing audience engagement, strengthening brand presence and supporting wider commercial and marketing objectives across a broad range of social channels.

Reporting into the Content Manager, you'll be responsible for planning, creating and publishing engaging social content across platforms including TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, X, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, Snapchat and Threads.

The role will involve a mixture of planned and reactive content, with responsibility for live coverage of key events and activity. You'll need to be comfortable working in fast-paced environments, reacting quickly to developments and producing accurate, engaging content under pressure.

Key Responsibilities of the Social Media Executive will include:
- Planning, creating and publishing high-quality, mobile-first social media content across multiple platforms.
- Taking a lead role in live social media coverage, including events and behind-the-scenes activity.
- Creating platform-specific content, adapting tone, format and creative execution to maximise engagement.
- Supporting campaigns, activations and commercial partnerships through effective social media content.
- Working closely with internal teams and external partners to deliver engaging campaigns and content.
- Monitoring social media performance, audience behaviour and emerging trends, using insights to continually improve content.
- Identifying new content opportunities, stories and trends that can increase engagement and audience growth.
- Keeping up to date with changes across social platforms, emerging formats and best practice.
- Supporting wider commercial, marketing and promotional activity across social channels.
- Building strong working relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners to support content creation.
- Editing and producing social assets using tools such as Adobe Creative Suite, CapCut and Canva.
- Ensuring all content is aligned with brand guidelines, tone of voice and relevant policies.

We're looking for a creative and organised social media professional who understands what makes content perform and isn't afraid to get stuck in.

You'll ideally have:
- Demonstrable experience creating high-performing, platform-native social media content.
- Strong knowledge of major social media platforms and the ability to adapt to changing trends and algorithms.
- Experience using Adobe Creative Suite, CapCut or similar editing software.
- A good understanding of social media analytics and performance metrics.
- The ability to plan effectively while remaining highly reactive when required.
- Confidence working in live, fast-paced and high-pressure environments.
- Excellent attention to detail and a strong understanding of brand and tone of voice.
- A creative mindset with the ability to identify new opportunities and develop engaging content ideas.

Elevation Recruitment Group's Marketing division is handling this vacancy. If you're a creative social media professional looking for your next opportunity and want to work in a fast-moving environment where no two days are the same, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Reception Administrator
description: This role is at the heart of our organisations day-to-day operations. As the first point of contact for many of our clients, visitors, and team members, youll play a vital part in creating a welcoming, professional, and efficient environment. We created this role to support our growing need for reliable, organised, and people-focused administrative support. Youll be joining a team that values collaboration, empowerment, attention to detail, and a proactive approach to problem-solving. Your work will help ensure that our front-of-house experience reflects the high standards we set across all our services. From managing enquiries and coordinating appointments to supporting internal processes, youll be instrumental in keeping things running smoothly and helping others do their best work. We provide the tools and support individuals need to challenge themselves and push their recovery to its fullest potential, empowering them not only to recover but to thrive. As a Reception Administrator at STEPS, you will provide the first point of contact for STEPS clients, visitors, external organisations and suppliers as well as providing vital administrative support for our service. You will work as part of a wider inter-disciplinary team with collective responsibility for delivering first-class service in rehabilitative care aligned with STEPS values and behaviours. We know that exceptional care begins with exceptional people. Thats why weve built a specialist interdisciplinary team, who bring not only skill and experience, but real compassion to every interaction. We employ 180+ team members in both clinical positions and in business support roles and we are proud of the culture we have established where all team members share our philosophy, values and dedication to delivering excellent client care. Our team is united by a common purpose, dedicated to continually learning from one another, and committed to giving their utmost for those we support. We invest and nurture the development of our team, and through training, shared learning, and research, we give them the tools to grow, stay inspired, and remain at the forefront of their area of work. This Job description is an outline which reflects the present requirements of the post and is not intended to be exhaustive list of duties the post holder will be expected to fulfil. To provide a professional, courteous and prompt first point of contact for clients, visiting families, guests and external visitors. To be responsible for providing a client-centred reception service which; - Deals with all enquiries appropriately, referring issues which cannot be resolved immediately by referring to the correct team member - Maintains appropriate call and action logs - Ensures that the correct processes are followed for client and guest sign in and sign out, including making sure people are aware of the correct site safety procedures - Carries out all start and end of day processes for reception - Ensures that the reception area and the admin office is kept tidy and presentable at all times - Takes delivery and sign for packages and post - Takes cash/card payments from clients and team members when necessary - Books taxis for clients and visitors when requested or agreed by a STEPS team member according to the relevant procedures To provide additional administrative support as appropriate, for example; - Typing up clinical notes as required - Input client timetables - Raise Invoices - Order clinical supplies, stationery and other equipment as requested To comply with STEPS policies and procedures at all times To maintain client confidentiality at all times whilst carrying out duties. To ensure confidentiality of information in respect of records maintained and tasks undertaken To undertake any other duties which may be specified from time to time by Head of Admin that are within the level and responsibility appropriate to the post To effectively communicate using a variety of styles that demonstrates the values and behaviours of STEPS. To communicate with people clearly and in a manner and at a level and pace appropriate to their abilities, preferences and beliefs. To be respectful of a clients dignity at all times and develop effective relationships with clients, their families, carers, the interdisciplinary team.
